correctness.rationale: Exact differentiation gives Ldot=2x²(1-y)²-a z². For a<0 the largest invariant subset of its zero set consists of the three equilibria; for a=0 it is the harmonic symmetry plane plus the two nonzero equilibria. Bounded forward orbits admit compact connected omega-limit sets. For nonzero x, convergence to the plane forces Cesaro mean y=0, hence exponential growth of |x|, a contradiction. Sign preservation then selects E±. On x=0 the damped/anti-damped oscillator is solved exactly. Invariant compact probabilities integrate the nonnegative Ldot to zero and hence lie on the specified invariant zero set; uniform harmonic circle measures follow from the unique invariant angular distribution. The standalone exact checker verifies the identities, equilibria and harmonic family.

value.rationale: The original work investigated symmetric chaotic attractors at positive damping, making the behavior at zero and negative damping an intrinsic model boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. A globally polynomial Lyapunov certificate determines the entire omega-limit selection of all bounded forward trajectories on a whole parameter half-line, identifies the exact harmonic foliation on the critical plane, and exhausts compact stationary measures. The result is global qualitative dynamics not obtainable from local equilibrium linearization or mere numerical replication; it does not claim global boundedness or positive-parameter chaos.
